newsitem.title: GERMANY: Novopharm unit gets U.S. rights to generic Zantac.
newsitem.headline: Novopharm unit gets U.S. rights to generic Zantac.

text.p: German drug group Merck KGaA said Monday its Genpharm Inc. subsidiary had signed a contract transferring the exclusive U.S. marketing rights for a generic version of the ulcer drug Zantac to Novopharm's Granutec Inc.
The ulcer drug, the chemical term for which is ranitidine hydrochloride, has annual sales of about $1.6 billion in the United States.
Merck said the transfer of the rights was contingent on the U.S. Food and Drug Administration allowing Granutec to market the product, a generic equivalent of Glaxo Wellcome Plc's Zantac.
